info.name: Ally Invest Market Data API
info.description:
The Ally Invest REST API (originally developed from the TradeKing acquisition) provides programmatic access to self-directed brokerage account management, order placement, real-time and delayed market data, watchlist management, and member profile information. Authentication uses OAuth 1.0 with consumer and token credentials. Responses are available in JSON and XML formats.

Contact Support:
 Email: InvestAPI@ally.com
